summary.en-US: Unofficial Firefox add-on for the CHRIST University CUE portal. Shows your effective attendance and how many classes you need to hit your target, overall and per subject. Runs entirely in your browser.

description.en-US: Adds clear attendance planning to the CHRIST University CUE student portal (cue.christuniversity.in). Attendance page - Effective attendance with co-curricular hours, and with medical leave when it applies - A Target card: set a target % and see how many more classes you need, or how many you can skip View Details (per subject) - Subject attendance, Present, Absent (co-curricular / medical / other) and the same Target card Follows the portal's own rules - Co-curricular hours are added back - Medical leave counts only between 74.50% and 84.49% (read from the portal) - A "Count medical" checkbox lets you ignore medical leave Privacy Runs only on cue.christuniversity.in. Makes no network requests and collects no data. Your target % is stored locally in your browser. Unofficial. Not affiliated with CHRIST (Deemed to be University). Source code: https://github.com/GPrabhanjana/cue-enhanced-attendance

version.approval_notes: This add-on only runs on the CHRIST University student portal (cue.christuniversity.in), which requires a student login that cannot be shared. It reads the attendance numbers already displayed on the Attendance and View Details pages and adds summary cards next to them; it makes no network requests and stores only the user's target % and settings in storage.local. Calculation logic is in content.js (plan() and pctAfter()). Source is plain, unminified JavaScript; public repo: https://github.com/GPrabhanjana/cue-enhanced-attendance
